notes: fact: Pires reports one to three Lequeos junks annually; Araújo dates Gores arrivals to January and exits to April (Pires I, p. 130; Cartas III, p. 9). See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §6.

inference: Use Araújo's dates for a rare call, conditional on the Gores identification; do not average January at Melaka with the Commentaries' January departure from origin. See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §6.
gameplay: Relative weights and month preferences are authored tuning, not observed traffic or compulsory departure dates.
